symptom.actual: A useful typed semantic patch was rejected, then the fallback portfolio failed delivery depth.
symptom.expected: The active server transaction binds CAS provenance; typed content is composed and revalidated without another PM/CE planning cycle.

root_causes.detail: Factory delegated opaque candidate/diagnosis identity to the LLM and discarded typed content when one copied hash nibble differed.
The composer corrected invalid owners only for artifact rows repeated by the provider. Three frozen tests remained owned by TASK-2 although TASK-3 was their unique immutable authority.

fix.summary: Parse the provider envelope strictly, bind only CAS provenance to the active server transaction, retain provider echoes as audit evidence, and normalize every uniquely unauthorized frozen artifact owner during a delivery-depth repair transaction.
guardrails: Semantic operation groups remain diagnosis-authorized and strictly parsed.
Malformed provenance values still fail closed during provider-envelope parsing.
Owner rebinding occurs only when immutable task authority yields exactly one authorized task.
No generated Bench project file is modified.
